entities.summary: Tchavolo Schmitt (b. 1954, 20th arrondissement of Paris) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in 20th arrondissement of Paris and France. Known in the fields of france, composers & musicians, europe.
